title: SAP S/4HANA Technical Architect
job_description:
Seeking a highly skilled SAP Technical Architect to lead the technical architecture, design, and

implementation of SAP S/4HANA RISE solutions within a complex and fast-paced retail

environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SAP S/4HANA technical

architecture, ABAP development, SAP BTP extensibility, and cloud-native integrations with AWS,

alongside a firm grasp of SAP Clean Core principles. This role will play a critical part in guiding cross

functional technical teams and ensuring delivery of reliable, scalable, and future-ready SAP solutions

across our retail ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the end-to-end technical design and architecture for SAP S/4HANA RISE projects, with

a focus on retail-specific use cases and cloud readiness.

• Drive the implementation of SAP Clean Core strategy, leveraging SAP BTP, embedded

Steampunk, and side-by-side extensibility while avoiding core modifications.

• Lead development and integration workstreams across SAP Retail, SAP CAR, and other

modules using modern ABAP (ABAP on HANA) and Fiori/UI5 technologies.

• Enable SAP Fiori adoption, including app extensibility, launchpad configuration, and UX

personalization for retail users.

• Coordinate integration with native AWS services (S3, SQS, Lambda, etc.) using AWS ABAP

SDK and secure API patterns.

• Support the execution of the Bluefield™ migration approach, ensuring modular

transformation while activating new S/4HANA innovations.

• Oversee technical delivery and development governance, ensuring compliance with coding

standards, performance benchmarks, and deployment best practices.

• Collaborate with functional leads, solution architects, and external partners to ensure

technical alignment and feasibility.

• Manage and mentor technical development teams across onshore/offshore delivery

models, driving consistency and quality.

• Ensure proper configuration of middleware, APIs, and DevOps tools to streamline CI/CD

pipelines and support agile delivery.

• Prepare and review technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and integration

specifications.

• Support all delivery phases including Fit-to-Standard workshops, SIT/UAT, cutover planning,

and hypercare.

Key Skills and Qualifications:

• Minimum of 2 full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations, including projects in the retail

industry and at least one hosted on SAP S/4HANA RISE.

• Strong technical expertise in SAP S/4HANA architecture, including ABAP (on HANA),

Fiori/UI5, CDS Views, BAPIs, and OData services.

• Experience working with SAP CAR, F&R, and other retail-specific SAP solutions.

• Practical experience integrating SAP with AWS services using AWS ABAP SDK, REST APIs, and

secure authentication.

• Hands-on experience with SAP BTP, in-app extensibility, and embedded Steampunk for

side-by-side extensions.

• Exposure to DevOps tools such as Git, Jenkins, JIRA, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

• Strong understanding of middleware technologies (e.g., SAP PI/PO, SAP Integration Suite, or

similar).

• Excellent technical documentation, architecture design, and stakeholder communication

skills.

• Proven track record managing technical teams and collaborating across global delivery

models.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field;

SAP technical certifications are preferred.

Together with our passionate and driven teams, you'll get to develop your skills, build on industry knowledge and collaborate with global teams in a dynamic space. Browse our Sea Labs Indonesia team openings to see how you can make an impact with us.

About team

The Enterprise Efficiency team is dedicated to transforming workplace productivity through seamless integration of enterprise communication, open platform capabilities, and management systems covering HR, finance, and operational tools. Our products power the daily workflows of thousands of employees across Sea group companies.

Our product lines include SeaTalk (enterprise communication and collaboration platform) and PFMS (People and Financial Management System). We are currently driving enterprise initiatives where we actively leverage AI-powered tools and LLM integrations to enhance product capabilities and accelerate engineering workflows.

Design and implement the test automation strategy across API, integration, and E2E layers for both SeaTalk and PFMS product lines.
Build and maintain CI/CD-integrated test pipelines that gate releases and run on every merge request.
Establish test environment management practices including reliable provisioning, data seeding, and environment parity with production.

Evaluate and select test frameworks and tooling; own the technical decisions on what we use and how we use it.
Own the regression testing strategy: define scope, maintain suites, and ensure regression cycles do not become release bottlenecks.
Act as the quality gate authority for production releases — define go/no-go criteria and enforce them consistently.
Drive test case design standards ensuring coverage aligns with PRD requirements and technical risk areas, not just happy paths.
Serve as the technical quality authority: set standards, conduct test design reviews, and coach QA engineers on automation skills and engineering best practices.
Collaborate with backend and frontend leads on testability improvements — advocate for contract testing, structured logging, and API design that supports automated verification.
Coordinate QA efforts across cross-site teams (Singapore, Shenzhen) during multi-team releases.
Participate in technical design reviews to identify test strategy early in the development lifecycle.
Communicate quality risks, test coverage gaps, and trade-offs clearly to product managers and engineering leadership.
5+ years of experience in software QA/quality engineering, with at least 3 years focused on test automation architecture and infrastructure.
Deep hands-on experience with at least two of: Selenium/WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress (E2E); pytest, JUnit, TestNG (API/unit); or equivalent frameworks.

Strong programming skills in at least one of: Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript — writes production-quality test code, not scripts.
Experience with API testing at scale: REST, contract testing, and service-level integration verification.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction without direct management authority — influences through expertise, standards, and results.
Experience working in cross-functional teams with frontend, backend, and product stakeholders.
Proficient in using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to accelerate testing, debugging, and documentation workflows.
General AI literacy — understands core AI/LLM concepts and can evaluate where AI capabilities can be practically applied to improve QA processes.

Comfortable working across time zones with distributed teams.

Kami mencari DevOps Engineer berpengalaman yang memiliki spesialisasi mendalam di bidang infrastruktur berbasis kontainer. Kubernetes Lifecycle: Merancang dan melakukan deployment Kubernetes cluster secara mandiri dari tahap awal (bare metal atau cloud-based).

Optimization: Melakukan tuning performa cluster, manajemen sumber daya (Resource Quotas, Limits), dan memastikan High Availability (HA).

CI/CD Pipeline: Membangun dan mengoptimalkan pipeline automasi untuk mempercepat pengiriman perangkat lunak ke lingkungan produksi.

Kebutuhan Teknis (Technical Skills)

K8s Expert: Pengalaman mendalam dalam mengelola Kubernetes (In-depth knowledge of Pods, Services, Ingress, Persistent Volumes, dan Helm Charts).

Containerization: Ahli dalam pembuatan dan optimasi Docker images.

Cloud Native Tools: Terbiasa dengan service mesh (seperti Istio/Linkerd) dan Ingress Controllers (Nginx/Traefik).

Cloud Provider: Berpengalaman mengelola infrastruktur di AWS, Google Cloud (GKE), atau Azure (AKS).

Linux Server: Kemampuan administrasi sistem Linux yang sangat kuat (Ubuntu/CentOS/Debian).

Scripting: Mahir dalam bahasa scripting seperti Bash, Python, atau Go untuk kebutuhan otomasi.

Pengalaman minimal 3-4 tahun sebagai DevOps Engineer atau Site Reliability Engineer (SRE).

Memiliki sertifikasi CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) akan menjadi nilai tambah yang sangat besar.

Memiliki pola pikir analitis dalam melakukan troubleshooting pada level infrastruktur yang kompleks.

title: Technology Lead (Indonesia)

We are looking for an innovative and hands-on Technology Lead who is passionate about using AI and advanced technologies to create scalable, impactful solutions in education. This role requires strong technical expertise, leadership, and a problem-solving mindset to guide our technology and engineering efforts in delivering high-quality, mission-driven products.

We value adaptability, ownership, and a commitment to continuous improvement. If you thrive on building systems, guiding technical decisions, leveraging cutting-edge technology, and solving complex challenges that change lives, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

This role is not light, routine, or heavily guided. You’ll be expected to handle ambiguity, move quickly across multiple priorities, and deliver production-ready solutions with little to no revision. You must be able to stay calm under pressure, take full responsibility for your tasks, and deliver reliable outputs — even when requirements shift mid-week or feedback requires immediate turnaround.

If you’re seeking a role that will stretch your technical capacity, sharpen your problem-solving, and accelerate your growth, and you’re prepared to meet high expectations, we want to hear from you.

Technology Leadership & Architecture: Lead the design and development of scalable, reliable technology platforms. Establish and maintain engineering standards, review technical implementations, and guide the adoption of AI, automation, and modern development practices to strengthen product capabilities.
Product Development & Innovation:Collaborate closely with product, design, and program teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions. Contribute hands-on to the development of secure, user-friendly edtech platforms, experimenting with emerging technologies to improve product features, performance, and scalability from prototyping through deployment.
Team Leadership & Capability Building: Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing engineering organisation. Systems, Infrastructure & Integration:Oversee system infrastructure, architecture, and data integration to ensure reliability, security, and scalability. Support the implementation of DevOps practices, automation pipelines, and secure system design to maintain efficient and resilient platforms.

What We’re Looking For

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.
Leadership & Delivery Experience:4–5 years of experience working in software engineering or technical leadership roles in fast-paced environments, with experience contributing to scalable platform development. Experience in edtech, AI, or mission-driven sectors is highly valued.
Technical Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, JavaScript/Node.js, and React, along with experience using cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
Solid background in data engineering, including ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehousing (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift), and scalable data architectures. Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks, APIs, automation, and system integration is highly desirable.
Core Competencies: Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking with the ability to make sound technical decisions. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions.
Location & Mission Fit: Based in Bandung or willing to relocate, with a strong interest in applying technology to solve real-world education challenges.
Bonus (Nice to Have): Experience in edtech or NGO environments, familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines, and knowledge of data privacy regulations and secure system design.

Why Join Us?

You’ll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don’t expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you’re looking for a conventional technology role, this may not be the right fit. But if you’re ready to build innovative solutions, lead technical initiatives, and create real-world impact through technology, we’d love to hear from you.

title: DevOps
job_description:
Description


DevOps Engineer adalah profesional IT yang bertanggung jawab menggabungkan proses development (Dev) dan operations (Ops) agar proses pengembangan, deployment, dan pengelolaan aplikasi berjalan lebih cepat, stabil, dan otomatis.

Berikut job desk / tanggung jawab utama DevOps Engineer:

1. Mengelola Infrastruktur Server
• Mengatur dan memelihara server, cloud, atau infrastruktur IT.
• Menggunakan platform seperti: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, VPS / dedicated server

2. Continuous Integration & Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)
• Membuat dan mengelola pipeline CI/CD untuk otomatisasi proses: build, test, deployment aplikasi
• Menggunakan tools seperti: Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions

3. Containerization dan Orchestration
• Mengelola aplikasi menggunakan container seperti: Docker
• Menggunakan orchestration tools seperti: Kubernetes, Docker Swarm

4. Monitoring dan Logging
• Memantau performa aplikasi dan server.
• Menggunakan tools seperti: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)

5. Automasi Infrastruktur
• Menggunakan Infrastructure as Code (IaC) untuk mengelola infrastruktur secara otomatis.
• Tools yang sering digunakan: Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi

6. Keamanan Sistem (Security)
• Mengelola security server dan aplikasi.
• Mengatur: firewall, access control, secrets management

7. Deployment Aplikasi
• Melakukan deployment aplikasi ke server atau cloud.
• Memastikan proses deployment berjalan tanpa downtime.

8. Kolaborasi dengan Tim Development

Job Requirement


• Salary : 15 juta (gross)
• Kuota kebutuhan : 1 orang (Middle Level)
• Minimal 3-5 tahun pengalaman sebagai DevOps

title: Data Engineer
job_description:
At VIDA we’re building the future of digital identity. As a Data Engineer you’ll work across the stack—from platform and infrastructure to data pipelines and end-user tooling. You’ll help us modernize our batch ETLs and lead our push into streaming and real-time fraud detection. We run on AWS and make extensive use of Scala Spark, dbt, and Terraform.Responsibilities


Build and expose the data lake/lakehouse so teams can understand business and product performance and make better decisions.

Design and evolve a data platform that enables scientists and analysts to query, model, and ship features and product metrics.

Develop scalable and reliable batch and streaming pipelines that ingest from varied sources and land trusted datasets.

Maintain and fix existing ETLs, improving reliability, observability, and cost while planning safe backfills and replays.

Model curated layers and maintain transformation logic (e.g., dbt), including testing, documentation, and data quality.

Build with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) and contribute to CI/CD and deployment practices.

Partner with Engineering, and Data Science to deliver low-latency signals and features for real-time decisioning.

Contribute to internal tools, reusable components, and simple dashboards that unblock self-service.

Requirements


Solid engineering foundation with 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering and/or distributed systems.

Hands-on work building data pipelines (batch and/or streaming) using at least one distributed framework (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Flink).

Comfortable with SQL and a transformation framework (e.g., dbt or similar).

Familiarity with AWS services for data (any mix of S3, EMR/Glue, Kinesis/MSK, Lambda, Redshift/Athena) or equivalent cloud experience.

Exposure to workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow).

Experience using Terraform (or similar IaC) to manage data/platform resources.

Ownership mindset, focus on reliability, and enjoyment of collaborating in a fast-moving environment.

What are we trying to solve?


Billions of people still cannot securely prove their identity. Without it, they’re shut out of education, healthcare, finance, and civic participation. We believe this must change—and that digital identity should be trustworthy, private, and accessible to everyone.

At VIDA, we’re creating a frictionless digital identity system that meets the needs of our time and works anywhere, for everyone.

Why are we solving this problem?


Global initiatives like the UN and World Bank’s ID4D aim to provide legal identity for all by 2030. We expect digital identity to become a basic right, and we want VIDA to help lead that future.

Who are we?


We’re a mission-driven, pragmatic team motivated by real-world impact—from preventing fraud and corruption to unlocking fair access to essential services. If that resonates with you, we’d love to talk.
